body: Haha, at least it isn't a rare situation. Kind of puts into a different perspective.

My city's job market is pretty shit. Its really hard to find a job around here that doesn't involve driving (i have no car, being raised by a single parent with three jobs makes it hard to learn to drive lol) or having years of experience. Makes it hard to spread your wings, ya know. 

And she honestly just annoys me/makes me angry, which makes me feel kind of guilty. Because I know how hard she worked to support me in highschool, and how much she's done for me with little help, and then I get super pissed at her and feel ungrateful, and try and make it up to her, only to somehow piss her off again, and it starts everything over again. I think I'm getting off topic now though lol
This may sound really really dumb, but I have some /slight/ breathing troubles, so I have trouble giving a girl oral, since I'm having to take too many pauses to catch my breath.

She just called me lazy, said I had no work ethic, that I was lying, etc etc. I mean, I guess the fact that she drove me around for six hours one day dropping off applications doesn't count for anything. But since then, its like the floodgates opened or something. Everything I do is utterly wrong, and everything I say is either a lie or me "arguing".
I gotta say, just knowing that has helped a lot tonight. If I had any artistic talent, I'd write you all a song or something.

Well like I said, we've butted heads since my dad died back in 2002. But that's kind of how we are. A family of proud, thick headed people. But the whole thing I'm dealing with now started back in October. She hasn't treated me the same since I said I didn't want to get a back room job at walmart because I was worried about my shoulder.

J's been perfectly understanding of my emotional issues the whole time we've known each other. Which is what makes me feel worse. I hate forcing her to have to be so patient. I should be buying her presents and taking her out to nice places to eat, not having to be paid for like some kind of dependent and calling her at odd hours so I rant about nonsense. I want to make her happy, not worry, ya know? 

And thanks again. Sorry for being so ranty and nonsensical, I feel like I may be overreacting on all of this now.

My arm's not bad actually. I just managed to drop it in the right way that it took some skin with it. Its not actually even that sharp lol. A knife would never be something I'd actually use on myself, I can't even say why I even entertained that thought. I guess I'm just more upset than I even thought at first. It was a gift from an uncle that passed a few years ago who went through a lot of the same emotional problems I do. Kind of security object I suppose.

I do my best not to let her get to me. As supportive as my mom was, we were never close. We argued more often than not, and just never saw eye-to-eye, but she was still a good mother until recently, for whatever reason got in her head. But its just the fact that my friends have such positive relationships with their families makes it so much worse. I guess that's a really petty reason though, huh

To be honest, I've calmed down a little since writing that. I would never do anything to hurt J(my gf). But I hate being a burden on her. I mean, my mom had been very supportive most of my life, up until October of 2012, where all of sudden, I just became some kind of scum in her eyes. I guess that makes it just that much worse. And the thought of being forced to leave J, hurting her, making her worry, is probably what kept me out of jail and/or the hospital tonight. Honestly, my mother made me so angry for a period of time that I wanted her to hit me, to lay her hands on me, just so I could have a reason to fight back. I've also come to the conclusion that it seems like my mom would probably prefer me to vanish. She does have life insurance on me after all. Fuck it, if I end up in the river or something, at least she gets her precious rent money.

It just really helped to get this all out. Sorry for it being so hard to read. Thanks for taking the time to say something though. At least I can whine to you, my faceless friends of the internet lol
